alternative_explanations: Unique relational fingerprints may encode the full semantic ontology, allowing exact graph canonicalization or MDL to explain all transfer without a distinct learned abstraction.
Search reduction may come only from grammar shortening after supplied complete primitive traces rather than robust cross-domain semantic acquisition.
confounds: The evaluator uses six fixed involutions over twelve states, complete primitive transition traces, runner-realized quick scoring seeds and synthetic programs; it isolates conjugacy-invariant library transfer but does not model open language, realistic perception or an LLM successor.
falsification_criteria: Keep HYP-0002 dormant if learned_relational_library has accuracy or near-equivalent accuracy below 0.95 in any cell, any false transfer or retention failure, or is matched in capability with equal-or-lower fit/state/update/R16 workload by relational_graph_mdl_library or bayesian_relational_library.

outcome_policy.negative: If the learned route is inaccurate, collision-prone or nonlocal, reject this implementation, preserve the failure and return HYP-0002 to dormant.
outcome_policy.null: If exact relational canonicalization or Bayesian/MDL sharing matches or dominates learned transfer, preserve the cross-representation mechanism as a classical control and return HYP-0002 to dormant without tuning this cohort.
outcome_policy.positive: Retain HYP-0002 as testing and permit one adversarial multi-seed screen only if learned behavioral alignment is exact in every cell, transfers to shuffled trace order and a local target update, and is implementably non-dominated by primitive, memo, semantic graph, Bayesian and MDL controls under full accounting.

predicted_outcome: All search-capable controls should preserve capability. Renaming plus state conjugacy should prevent syntactic or unary libraries from reducing search. Relational graph MDL, Bayesian alignment and learned relational alignment should recover the invariant macro and reduce D=4/6 search with query work independent of distractor-corpus K. The learned route is expected to match rather than beat exact relational graph canonicalization after fit, state, update and R16 accounting, making classical semantic canonicalization the likely null; oracle is reported only as a lower bound.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote. A screen is allowed only if learned relational alignment is exact in every cell, transfers to shuffled trace order and a local target update, and is implementably non-dominated by primitive, memo, semantic graph, Bayesian and MDL controls under full accounting.
research_question: Can a learned relational library align opaque primitives across independently renamed and state-conjugated DSLs, transfer a reusable operation to held-out synthesis, and lower full amortized search cost beyond exact semantic graph matching, MDL and Bayesian controls?
title: Behavioral-conjugacy transfer of reusable program libraries
